checks: The engine accepts the barrier only from its application service. A held barrier rejects direct mutations and still serves document reads.
A failed snapshot releases the admission barriers and leaves no public backup destination.
An admitted upload drained. New writes briefly returned a retryable response, while file and editor reads kept serving. Open Yjs clients continued afterwards on the same supervisor.
Checksums reject tampered bytes and restore refuses an existing working directory. Signing identity and Yjs bytes survive a verified restore.
The restored service reopened the original DOCX with the synchronized text that was awaiting autosave at the cut. A fresh native DOCX export preserved that text and excluded the later edits.
The surviving Provider job committed the retained revision through the original publication ID. The business version list and original bytes remained intact.
